entries.title: II Chronicles 27:2
segments: He entered not into the temple; as Uzziah rashly did to burn incense.
Men who imitate the virtues and avoid the vices of those who have gone before them, may expect the blessing of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:3
segments: Ophel; a ridge on the eastern side of Jerusalem running in a southern direction from Moriah, and terminating at the junction of the valley of Hinnom with the valley of Jehoshaphat.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:6
segments: Those who in all their ways acknowledge God, and whatever they do, do it heartily from love to his name and service, will rise to great eminence in spiritual life, be blessed in death, and glorious to eternity.
